svg.text: Two planes. A design plane of chat and background builders writes agent config files to disk; a run plane reads them back.
all run / step / board events, run-scoped
one pattern at two scales - the agent edits files, the files sync back to the DB
the chat panel of the workflow editor - this is where you type
DB -> repo -> agent edits files -> repo -> DB
one dispatch per node - on board submit, or the Generate button
background, in a container - recorded as execution_type = 'dispatch'
same projection one level down: agents within a single node
legacy, superseded by the Workflow Agent:
L1 Manager Assistant + L2 Manager Builder (ManagerDispatchStrategy), execution_mode == "manager" - 0 rows, 0 sessions
config files on the shared filesystem
live when state.workspace().is_some() - not gated on container_enabled
board element id = step id = system_node directory name
topological_sort_levels() . steps in one level run in a JoinSet
guards first: cancellation . pinned replay . dead-path . conditional edges
execution_mode decides ONLY the first arm; the rest routes on a column
only two of the six strategies are reachable from a DAG step
3 . WORKFORCE PIPELINE - across agents inside one step
agents declare depends_on -> levels -> same level runs concurrently
4 . EXECUTION ENGINE - one loop for every LLM call
on_start -> LLM -> on_response -> tool dispatch -> on_output
7 filters compose behaviour: agent_guidance . few_shot . reasoning_trace
steps in one level write through OverlayFS; diffs merge before the next
classify -> diff3 -> LLM conflict resolve -> verify -> persist
verify: non-empty . plausible length . imports kept . still parses
every canvas edit is filtered before it can cost an LLM call
diff.rs snapshot diff by element id -> changeset
filter.rs 1 pan 2 whitespace 3 oscillation 4 reorder 5 scoring 6 topo sort
structural edits (delete, rewire) -> written straight to the DB, always
aggregate_score >= dispatch_threshold -> wake an agent; below it, dropped
protocols 0 rows - compiler registry is empty
anthropic . ollama . noop clients exist, unused
Dormant, and drawn nowhere above: the protocol compiler (hub/protocols) has an empty registry and no way to fill it - register() needs &mut on an Arc-wrapped engine.
